text: This report recommends approving a contract to R. Galati Contracting Ltd. for the provision of all labour and equipment necessary for snow removal services as requested by Exhibition Place. This recommendation follows the competitive Request for Quotations process undertaken by Exhibition Place with solicitations to 7 GTA companies that provide these services.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Approved a contract with R. Galati Contracting Ltd. for the non-exclusive provision of snow removal services for a one-year term with three one-year options to renew on the terms and conditions set out in the report (September 6, 2018) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place and such other terms and conditions required by the Chief Executive Officer and City Solicitor.
